@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+---
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: 'Thread-level types: ThreadState, Plan, TerminalRecord, ConfigOption, SlashCommand, ContextUsage, pending requests (plan §3.2, §3.4)'
+---
+## What
+Create the non-item model types in `Sources/AgentViewKit/Model/`, per plan.md §3.2 and §3.4.
+
+- `ThreadState.swift`: `idle(StopReason?)`, `running`, `requiresAction`. `StopReason`: `endTurn, maxTokens, maxTurnRequests, refusal, cancelled, unknown(String)`.
+- `Plan.swift`: `Plan { id: PlanID; entries: [PlanEntry] }`, `PlanEntry { content, priority (high, medium, low, unknown), status (pending, inProgress, completed, cancelled, unknown) }`.
+- `TerminalRecord.swift`: `@Observable` class with `id`, `command`, `cwd`, `exitStatus (code, signal)`, `output: Data`, `revision`.
+- `ConfigOption.swift`: `id`, `name`, `category (mode, model, modelConfig, thoughtLevel, unknown)`, `kind`: `select(current, options or groups)` or `boolean(current)`. `ConfigValue`: `id(String)`, `boolean(Bool)`.
+- `SlashCommand.swift`: `name`, `description`, `inputHint`.
+- `ContextUsage.swift`: `used`, `size`, `cost (amount, currency)?`, `input (total, cached)?`, `output (total, reasoning)?`, `quota (belowLimit(approaching), limitReached)?`. Computed `fraction`.
+- `ThreadInfo.swift`: `title`, `updatedAt`.
+- `PermissionRequest.swift`: `id`, `title`, `description`, `subject (toolCall(id) or command(command, cwd, toolCallId, terminalId))`, `options: [PermissionOption]` with `kind (allowOnce, allowAlways, rejectOnce, rejectAlways, unknown)`. `PermissionDecision { outcome: selected(optionId) or cancelled; comment: String? }`.
+- `ElicitationRequest.swift`: `id`, `server`, `message`, `mode: form(schema) or url(url, elicitationId)`. `ElicitationResult`: `accept(JSONValue?)`, `decline`, `cancel`.
+- `AuthorizationRequest.swift`: `id`, `serverName`, `scopes`, `authorizationURL`.
+- `AuthMethod.swift`: `agent(id, name)`, `terminal(id, name, args, env)`.
+- `AgentThreadActions.swift`: the protocol from §3.4 with `send`, `cancel`, `respond(to: PermissionRequest,_:)`, `respond(to: ElicitationRequest,_:)`, `setConfigOption`, `connect`, `login`, `runTerminalAuth`, `logout`. Add `NoopThreadActions` in the test support folder.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Every enum has an `unknown` case and decodes an unknown wire string into it.
+- [ ] `ContextUsage.fraction` is `used / size` and clamps to `0...1`.
+- [ ] `NoopThreadActions` records every call for assertions.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Model/ThreadStateTests.swift`: stop reason mapping.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Model/ContextUsageTests.swift`: fraction and clamp.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Model/ConfigOptionTests.swift`: select with flat options and with groups.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #foundation #model
\ No newline at end of file
